plugins.description: An envision step that shows someone still forming an idea 2-4 rough versions of it on an offline board and gets an agreement in chat before anything is specified, a context-builder that bootstraps a new project's shared context before anything else runs, clean-code quality gates, a commit/PR helper, a validation-error fixer, a code-cleanup simplify pass, a design-to-code translator, a multi-agent pipeline orchestrator with opt-in parallel lane execution, a lightweight orchestrator-flash sibling that trades verification for speed and says which checks it skipped, a roadmap planner, an autonomous product-manager that drives roadmap stories end-to-end, a pr-review-report skill that emits an interactive HTML PR review with project memory, an explain-codebase skill that emits an interactive HTML explanation of any codebase, a flutter-envs skill that separates a Flutter app's environments (ids, icons and names, an environment banner, a Firebase project per environment, gitignored env files) and proves it with real builds, and a vendored spec-driven-eval skill (CC-BY-4.0, Waldemar Neto) that grades an implementation against its PRD.
